$note: Soul Lane 3 — XP curve + sources + anti-farming. Separates VERIFIED current values from PROPOSAL additions. All integer, deterministic. Snapshot 2c3a9055d71a87ed3ed8b8abf08503efa1218f7c.

VERIFIED_curve.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT
VERIFIED_curve.note: Quadratic curve. Early levels fast, late levels slow — matches 'avoid giant perk trees' and a bounded 30-day campaign.

entries.anti_farm: RewardedRegions set — paid ONCE per region ever
ResolvedEncounters set — each encounter id resolves once; +600 gold once per newly held region.
entries.notes: Only the Human player hero (Aurora) currently receives XP. DwarfCommander receives none.

PROPOSAL_sources_v0.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
PROPOSAL_sources_v0.principle: Keep existing two sources authoritative; ADD only deterministic, one-shot or diminishing sources so grinding is never optimal. All new XP flows through FSoulHeroRules::AddExperience, never a parallel accumulator.

entries.proposal: XP = base(360) scaled by a bounded difficulty factor from the authoritative result, clamped. Suggested: 360 + clamp( (EnemyStrategicCount - PlayerStrategicCount) * 10, -120, +240 ). Uses only descriptor/result counts already present (PlayerStrategicCount, EnemyStrategicCount, PlayerSurvivors, EnemySurvivors). Deterministic.
entries.anti_farm: Still gated by ResolvedEncounters (one-shot per encounter).

entries.proposal: Small fixed XP on a LOST but survived battle (e.g. 60) so a wounded-but-alive hero still progresses slowly, discouraging save-scum reloads. Zero on capture.
One-time bonus XP (e.g. +500) when a hero commanded a successful siege resolution (R.bSiege && R.bPlayerWon && hero was commander). Uses existing siege result fields.
entries.anti_farm: Keyed by (hero, settlement) so the same hold cannot be re-sieged for XP; recapture churn yields diminishing returns (see anti_farming).

entries.proposal: Tiny XP (e.g. +40) the FIRST time a hero works a strategic site (windmill/quarry/shrine). Reuses InteractHeartlandSite + a per-site 'first worked by hero' flag.
entries.anti_farm: One-shot per site via the existing HeartlandSiteDays cooldown map plus a first-use set.

entries.proposal: Small XP (e.g. +80) on a successful diplomatic action executed by an Envoy-assigned hero. Hooks ExecuteDiplomacy (Lane 4/Diplomacy V1 coordination).
entries.anti_farm: Per-faction-per-action-type one-shot; repeated identical actions give nothing.

anti_farming.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL (built on VERIFIED one-shot gates)
verified_mechanisms: HeartlandSiteDays cooldown (site cannot be worked twice same day)

proposed_mechanisms.rule: XP for capturing a region decays per re-capture of the SAME region id by the same faction within the campaign: payout = base >> min(recaptures, 3) (i.e. 140, 70, 35, 17, floor). Prevents capture/lose/recapture churn farming (coordinated with Lane 2 anti-degeneracy).
Spending/regaining mana grants NO XP. Casting is not an XP source — prevents spell-spam farming.

Controlled/AI-vs-AI encounters resolved for non-player factions (bSixFactionProfile branch) grant the player hero no XP. VERIFIED: current code only calls AddExperience(Hero,...) on the real Human path.

At Level 10 (PROPOSAL cap) AddExperience still accumulates Experience but grants no further skill points once UnspentSkillPoints logic reaches the cap. Mirrors veterancy saturation (FSoulVeterancy saturates XP at MAX_int32 without inventing a sixth rank).

worked_examples.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL projection using VERIFIED curve + VERIFIED sources

conservative_player_30d.assumption: ~8 region captures (140 ea) + ~6 battle wins (360 ea)

worked_examples.note: Confirms L10 cap is a stretch goal within 30 days; most heroes finish a campaign at L5-L8. Feeds Lane 9 balance model.
